_comment: Example structure for a basement remedial inspection. Claude fills this per job from the OneNote narrative + context email. 'template' may be omitted to auto-find the latest Form 331.

particulars.Weather: Overcast; wet underfoot, elevated groundwater (refer Photo 1)
particulars.StageOfWorks: Occupied building – remedial drainage works, Basement 2

observations: [Project Name] is an occupied residential apartment building. A stormwater / drainage line runs beneath the 450mm raft slab serving Basement 2.
Over the past couple of weeks a minor leak was identified in the Basement 2 slab. [Drainage contractor] was engaged to CCTV the line and re-line a previously re-lined section of pipe.
During rectification, [Drainage contractor] cut out the failed liner. Once cut, full water-table head pressure came through, making re-lining impossible and flooding Basement 2.
Option 1 – Larger pump to draw water down enough to complete cutting and install the new liner. Preferred first course of action.
Basement 2 unusable and cordoned off. Sulphur odour permeating upper levels via the lift shaft.
Proceed with Option 1 (larger pump). On-site coordination meeting Mon 1 June 2026, 1:00pm.
captions: Photo 1 – Site frontage: water discharging across the footpath and kerb (ref 1.1).
